title: What's the Difference Between Primary and Secondary Sources in History?
skills: distinguish primary sources from secondary sources
classify sources based on their relationship to an event or topic
evaluate how different source types contribute to research
select appropriate evidence for academic inquiry and analysis
alignment_note: Explains the distinction between primary and secondary sources and how each type contributes differently to research and interpretation. Supports source evaluation, evidence selection, research writing, historical context, and information literacy across high school English courses.
